title: LeNet-5 / Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition
summary: Yann LeCun, Léon Bottou, Yoshua Bengio, and Patrick Haffner published 'Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition' in Proceedings of the IEEE in 1998. The paper documents convolutional neural networks for handwritten-character and document recognition and includes the LeNet-5 architecture in its experimental treatment.
significance: A documented convolutional-neural-network and document-recognition milestone that records LeNet-5 within a primary 1998 publication by its authors.
